source_holds.finding: Company-distributed release confirms a GBP4m Series A follow-on led by Octopus Ventures alongside Seraphim, but the earlier 2020 parent event and later strategic financing need one coherent history before import.
Discovery results report seed and grant financing, but no issuer or transaction-party source establishing the precise event terms was verified in this run.

Company pages confirm strategic investment, grants and crowdfunding, but the Expanding Dreams page combines investment, smaller investors and tax relief into a EUR2m runway rather than a clean round amount; award dates also require reconciliation.

The company states EUR5.5m was contributed across 2019 and 2020, so it cannot be imported as one fresh round. Later KMW and EDGE transactions are ownership changes with undisclosed primary-versus-secondary proceeds.
Investor portfolio evidence and secondary reports indicate financing, but issuer announcements and exact closing chronology were not established sufficiently for event import.
Company sources describe internal R&D spending and partially grant-funded expansion, not a disclosed external financing round or company grant amount.
Company materials and Lakestar's portfolio establish backing, but widely reported round amounts and dates were not confirmed by an issuer or transaction-party financing announcement in this run.
